item.title: Free Etsy Pricing Calculator: Stop Guessing Handmade Item Prices
item.description: Before: price equals materials times two, fees forgotten, labor unpaid, busy but not profitable. Maker Margin Lab is a free calculator that does it. Tap to get it free.

item.title: Free Etsy Pricing Calculator: Pricing Checklist for Every New Product
item.description: A small business pricing checklist for makers: add materials from your library, add labor at your hourly rate, pick your selling platform, check profit and margin, use the .99 target price and compare wholesale and retail. Repeat it for every new product. Maker Margin Lab does the math for free in Excel or Google Sheets. Tap to download.
